purpose: Investigate on frozen reads whether the different spatial memories or object-pointer tails in the recent-window and temporal-spread trajectories change the existing SAM2 object-presence logit and mask. This follows the observed seq23 late recovery in recent history and absent outputs in spread history; it is selected post-hoc.
scope: Sequence 3 engineering reads 8,12, then previously inspected inset-excluded seq23 reads 8,20,35,48,51. Reproduce the archived recent-window trajectory with the existing read-only attention/decoder observer and check every mask and trace; reuse the already verified spread captures. Verify two independent recent engineering captures before seq23 capture.
method: Using the same author Lean checkpoint and existing indexed spatial RoPE, reconstruct each saved attention/decoder no-op exactly. Confirm same frame, image, automatic prompt, conditioning memory, spatial/pointer key counts, and where possible exact current image query and decoder image features. Exchange in both directions (a) all nonconditioning spatial features together with their positions while retaining recipient pointers, (b) pointer-tail features and positions while retaining recipient spatial memory, and (c) the matched newest 4096-token spatial entry with positions, retaining all other recipient keys. Source entries, temporal slots and propagated errors may differ. Only recipient query, image inputs and decoder state are used for each of its comparisons; no feedback, new confidence threshold, object-presence modification, new learned parameters, target-label input or later redetection.
verification: First run two independent seq3 observer and exchange engineering replays, verify exact saved no-op attention/decoder/masks, donor and recipient block contents, paired positions, pointer suffix, spatial RoPE indices, parameter identity and key counts. Require checkpoint and source checks. Then repeat sequence 23 exchanges twice in independent processes, verify source snapshots and tensor equality and recompute no-op and exchanged native object logits and normal masks. Freeze outputs before opening labels; independently score Dice and labeled-empty false alarms and count changed pixels.
interpretation: Both source trajectories were affected by their prior predictions. Exchanging their memories (especially full spatial state) also changes source ages, positions, insurance and feature values together. This is a local conditional intervention and cannot isolate the reason for the full-video difference, prove a useful-token ranking or justify changing the native presence rule. Comparisons are post-hoc, selected and not independent generalization.
